approved_scope.title: Bring the current protocol and language libraries into one repository
approved_scope.description: Bring the current protocol and language libraries into one repository
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: The wire format stays protocols 0x01 and 0x02 with a 4096-byte note. This commit relocates the existing documents and libraries.
acceptance_criteria: The protocol documents and the TypeScript, Swift, Python, Rust, Kotlin, and Go libraries from their 4096-byte note releases are in this repository. Protocols stay 0x01 and 0x02. Post-quantum envelopes are absent. hi check passes and bun scripts/validate.ts passes.
